item.text: {"representations":[{"case_ref":"sample_8ca46d97901f44a3","text":"Across March 30–April 12, measurements stayed close to the preceding 28-day baseline: sleep 470.6 versus 470.3 min, steps 8,008 versus 8,039/day, low movement 452 versus 450 min, and resting heart rate 55.9 versus 56.2 bpm. Activity increased modestly to 57.8 from 55.2 min, remaining one continuous bout starting at 21:00. Sleep starts stayed near 22:49 and wakes at 07:00, without sustained change. Weekend sleep averaged 468 versus 472 weekday minutes, reversing a similarly small baseline difference. RMSSD averaged 40 ms in both periods; daily variation narrowed from 26–54 to 28–52 ms and remained greater on weekdays. Low movement comprised ten daytime bouts separated by five-minute gaps.
